title: Zombie Outbreak Day 3: The Fuel Dock (3/3)

characters.Kai: KAI; one flip-flop left until Part 3, then barefoot
characters.Dana: nurse in teal hospital scrubs, voice [woman]; worked with Tess's mother at Mercy Hospital

scenes.narration: Someone is trapped in the marina office. Sixty infected are on the pier. And the generator is still calling more.
[man] We have fuel. [man] We leave now.
Kai looked at the generator shed. As long as it ran, they would keep coming.
But every engine has one weakness. It has to breathe.
Block the air intake, and an engine dies in seconds.
They rowed the dinghy to the shed in silence. Oars wrapped in rags.
Kai stuffed his last flip-flop into the air intake.
The engine choked. Coughed. And died.
The lights went out. Total silence.
And the infected stopped. No sound. No light. Nothing to follow.
[kai] Could be worse. [kai] I had one flip-flop.
They reached the office window. A woman in hospital scrubs climbed out.
She had started the generator on purpose. A signal. She had been alone for two days.
Kai was barefoot. Soaked in diesel. But somehow, the shirt survived. Spotless.
Then the woman looked at Tess. At her yellow hoodie. [woman] Tess, is that you?
[woman] I worked with your mother. [woman] She's alive.
Would you have gone back? Tell me. Day four is tomorrow.
